theorems.name: Submission.smr_riesz_continuous_forms
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ L : (Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k) → ℝ, (∀ φ ψ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ U → L (φ + ψ) = L φ + L ψ) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k), Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → L (c • φ) = c * L φ) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ K → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (φ x) ≤ 1) → |L φ| ≤ B) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → Integrable (fun x => v x (φ x)) μ ∧ L φ = ∫ x, v x (φ x) ∂μ) ∧ μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, Measurable (fun x => v x α)) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 ∧ v x α = 1
